required: Two numerator factors and one denominator factor, with at least one non-unit power. Condense positive pair before the negative term. Numeric canonical family has a positive powered constant plus log(variable) minus log(constant).
excluded: One numerator factor over two denominator factors; one positive term with two negative terms; no nontrivial powers. These can bypass the product rule.
distractors: May retain alternative sign partitions; these are never selected as an out-of-scope correct target.
source_replay: Captured source prompts, banks, and existing solutions retained.
